name: Plain Baked Russet Potato (Fluffy Flesh Only — Discard Skin!)
whyItWorks: The fluffy white interior of a baked Russet potato is one of the most biocompatible starches on earth for IBD patients. It delivers easily digestible complex carbs, potassium, and comfort with zero mechanical gut irritation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake or microwave whole potato until soft to the touch. Slice open and scoop out ONLY the fluffy white interior. Completely discard the leathery, fibrous outer potato skin.
watchOuts: Crucial stricture safety rule: NEVER eat the baked potato skin! Potato skins are insoluble cellulose that cannot be digested.
